card.fires_on: The first piece of the word dose ("-d" or " D") when the word is split just before "ose". It appears in compounds like first-dose, high-dose, and in headings like Missed Dose.

modes.label: Hyphenated dose compounds
modes.description: The "-d" or "-D" piece of dose after a modifier such as first, high, full, or flexible.

modes.description: A separate " D" piece before "ose" or "oses" in section titles such as Missed Dose or a dose modification table.
